question: When can I retire with an unreduced pension?

gold_sections.ref: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-401

nuggets.text: A member hired on or after 1 July 2011 retires unreduced with age plus service of 90.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-401
nuggets.quote: has at least 90 years of combined age and years of eligibility service; or

nuggets.text: Or at 65 with 10 years of eligibility service.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-401
nuggets.quote: is at least 65 years old and has at least 10 years of eligibility service.

nuggets.text: The member submits a written application to the Board of Trustees stating the retirement date.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-401
nuggets.quote: the member completes and submits a written application to the Board of Trustees stating the date when the member desires to retire; and

nuggets.text: Earlier members: 30 years of service, or 62 with 5 (63/4, 64/3, 65/2).
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 23-401
nuggets.quote: has at least 30 years of eligibility service;

notes: § 23-401 is the Employees' and Teachers' Pension Systems' normal service retirement; other systems have their own sections.
